name: Għar Lapsi
description: Small sheltered cove on the south coast of Malta, one of the few shore entries there. Known for a shallow, sunlit cave system over 40 m long with many openings. Reefs (Finger Reef, Middle Reef, Black John) and an underwater nativity crib at 22 m are nearby.
conditions: Steep steps down to the water; currents are common offshore.
